description: Get the hosted Stripe payment link, only after the buyer confirmed the saved details and total: send buyer_confirmed=true, that details_version, that total and an idempotency_key (reuse it on retries). Creates an unpaid order; nothing is charged until the buyer, or an agent they explicitly authorized, pays on Stripe. Then poll get_order.

buyer_confirmed.description: true only after the buyer confirmed these details and this total.

expected_total.description: The total the buyer confirmed, in SGD cents.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

idempotency_key.description: A new random key per purchase. Retry with the same key and exact input; never reuse it for a different purchase.

name: prepare_payment
